Asha (CSM): Morning team — kicking off Cascade Health onboarding. Nina (client POC) wants production integration within ~6 weeks. Quick sync: who owns what, top risks, and proposed timeline? :wave:
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Morning. Need to confirm expected QPS and model variant (they mentioned an open LLM). Also they prefer VPC peering + restricted egress. I can draft an infra checklist.
Taylor (Implementation Manager): I'll run enablement. Proposal: 4 workshops (Discovery, Infra/setup, Prompt tuning, Go-live ops). Prefer Wed mornings — I'll send a Doodle.
Evan (CS Lead): Flagging a potential renewal risk: their legal team needs a DPA + security docs review; that often takes 2–3 weeks. Recommend we loop Legal in week 1 and get DPA draft out asap.
Asha (CSM): Agreed — success criteria I want tracked: 1) Prod p50 latency <200ms for target load, 2) 99.9% availability during business hours, 3) Integration test suite green, 4) Internal runbook + enablement completed. I'll add these to the onboarding doc and share. :memo:
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Draft infra checklist (will attach to doc):
```
- VPC peering configured
- Firewall rules for inference subnet
- Service account with kms/encryption access
- S3 (or equivalent) model artifact access
- Monitoring endpoints (Prometheus / traces)
```
OnboardBot: Calendar invites sent for initial Discovery workshop (Wed 10:00–11:00 PT) and Infra deep-dive (Thu 09:00–10:30 PT). Links: https://calendar.redwood.example/cascade-workshops
Taylor (Implementation Manager): I'll send the detailed ramp plan & workshop outlines by EOD. Who will own prompt tuning in phase 1?
Asha (CSM): Miguel will lead prompt tuning; Taylor coordinates sessions and recordings for their team.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): I'll also prepare a short checklist for performance baselining during the first week.
Asha (CSM): Great — next steps: (1) Miguel posts infra checklist in the doc, (2) Taylor sends poll for recurring enablement times, (3) Evan loop Legal with DPA draft, (4) I’ll confirm client stakeholders and share stakeholder RACI. If no blockers, we aim to hit the first workshop next Wednesday. :thumbsup:
Evan (CS Lead): Noted. I'll draft the RACI template and share in-thread.
Asha (CSM): Thanks everyone — feel free to ping here if anything changes. Closing for now, will update thread after invites & doc updates. :lock:
